# Nell Harcourt & Pidgeon

- [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md) — Mentor of — [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — school teacher and pupil · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde walk to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school together while discussing their schoolmates and their beautiful surroundings. During afternoon classes, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her hair, prompting an enraged [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to smash her slate over his head.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038)_

> In class, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her red hair, prompting her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md) punishes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by forcing her to stand at the front of the room and later making her sit beside Hugh, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to declare that she will never return to school. Upon returning home, [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) seeks advice from [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), who recommends letting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rest at home until her temper subsides.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)_

> Following Agatha's advice, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) decides not to force [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) back to school, allowing her to study at home instead. Though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stubbornly refuses to forgive [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), she grows deeply attached to Isolde. [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) later finds [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) weeping dramatically over the imagined future heartbreak of Isolde marrying and leaving her, which moves [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to rare, genuine laughter.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P97](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0097)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gets permission from [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to host Isolde for an afternoon tea while [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) is away in [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford). When Isolde arrives, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) serves her several glasses of what she believes to be raspberry cordial. Isolde becomes dizzy and ill from the drink, forcing her to leave prematurely before they can even have tea.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI. Isolde Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Isolde Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P7](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. > [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) convinces [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) to let her stay at Isolde's and go to the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert. After enjoying the concert and performances, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde return to the [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) home late at night, where they inadvertently jump into bed on top of Isolde's visiting [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home on the last day of school, emotional over Mr. Pidgeon's departure and discussing the upcoming arrival of the new clergyman, Mr. [Wace](../character/wace.md), and his wife. She later discusses the church's new leadership, her Sunday school experiences, and her excitement about baking a cake for the new minister's visit, which she practices for while spending time with Isolde by the Nymph's Well.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), and Hugh discuss their differing views on classroom discipline before beginning their upcoming teaching terms. Afterward, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks home to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), avoiding Mrs. Sowerby to instead converse with Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) about her plan to rule her school with affection. The next morning, a nervous [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares her anxieties over breakfast with [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).
>
